title: Reliance Trust Co. of Delaware Sells 1,654 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Reliance Trust Co. of Delaware trimmed its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.4% during the 2nd quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The institutional investor owned 46,467 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,654 shares during the period. Apple makes up approximately 1.4% of Reliance Trust Co. of Delaware’s holdings, making the stock its 7th biggest holding. Reliance Trust Co. of Delaware’s holdings in Apple were worth $8,602,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
Several other institutional investors and hedge funds have also recently modified their holdings of the company. Sabal Trust CO raised its holdings in Apple by 0.8% during the 2nd quarter. Sabal Trust CO now owns 126,139 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $23,349,000 after buying an additional 976 shares during the period. Rathbone Brothers plc raised its holdings in Apple by 6.5% during the 2nd quarter. Rathbone Brothers plc now owns 410,838 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $76,050,000 after buying an additional 25,236 shares during the period. TRUE Private Wealth Advisors raised its holdings in Apple by 6.6% during the 2nd quarter. TRUE Private Wealth Advisors now owns 47,352 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $8,765,000 after buying an additional 2,943 shares during the period. LGT Capital Partners LTD. raised its holdings in Apple by 7.3% during the 2nd quarter. LGT Capital Partners LTD. now owns 25,560 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,731,000 after buying an additional 1,730 shares during the period. Finally, Addenda Capital Inc. raised its holdings in Apple by 91.5% during the 2nd quarter. Addenda Capital Inc. now owns 155,634 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $27,400,000 after buying an additional 74,349 shares during the period. 58.58% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. In related news, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 14,194 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, October 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $227.96, for a total transaction of $3,235,664.24. Following the sale, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $24,058,442.48. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website . Also, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, August 27th. The shares were sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 579,837 shares of company stock worth $127,420,910 in the last three months. Corporate insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
AAPL has been the topic of several recent research reports. Argus increased their price target on Apple from $210.00 to $225.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, June 8th. BidaskClub lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Friday, June 8th. Macquarie restated a “buy” rating and set a $197.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, June 11th. UBS Group set a $210.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday, June 13th. Finally, Sanford C. Bernstein restated a “neutral” rating and set a $190.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, June 25th. Two investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have issued a hold rating and thirty have issued a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $220.78.
AAPL opened at $224.29 on Friday. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $150.24 and a 12-month high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a current ratio of 1.31. The firm has a market cap of $1,109.54 billion, a PE ratio of 24.35, a PEG ratio of 1.99 and a beta of 1.36.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company earned $1.67 EPS. The business’s revenue was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. On average, equities analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 EPS for the current year.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
